name: web-looping-words-selector-with-faded-condensed-caps-and-red-brackets
title: Cream page with a vertical scroller of heavy condensed words 'WORDS SELECTOR' fading up and down under red corner brackets
whatItIs: A cream page with a centred stack of heavy condensed uppercase words, where the middle two ('WORDS', 'SELECTOR') are plum with a vertical gradient and the lines above and below fade to grey, framed by small red corner brackets like a camera focus.
whatItMeans: Kinetic and focused; fading neighbours and brackets make one word feel selected.
techniques: Stack words in a vertical scroller.
Frame the selection with red corner brackets.

vocabulary.definition: A vertical list of words that loops.
Corner marks indicating the selected item.
A gradient hiding the ends of a list.
